bank_for_section_note: Anything you add here is chosen for {section}: this section draws it first, and no other section can. It still has to match one of this section's rules — the Question Bank is your reusable library, the pool is what this exam may draw from.
bp_intro: Name what you want - a subject, a type, a difficulty and a count - and the pool fills itself from the bank. Leave a field blank to mean “any”.
cand_already_sat_hint: This candidate has already sat the exam, so their assignment stays.
cand_emails_hint: One per line, or separated by commas. Emails with no account are reported.
cand_nobody_assigned_body: Only assigned candidates ever see this exam.
cand_nobody_left_all_body: Every candidate account is already assigned to this exam.
cand_nobody_left_approved_body: Everyone approved is already assigned. Untick the filter to see accounts still waiting on login access.
cand_save_draft_first_body: Candidates are assigned to an exam, so the exam has to exist before anyone can be assigned to it.
cand_some_cannot_sign_in: Some assigned candidates cannot sign in yet.
examiner_only_note: — examiner only, never sent to a candidate.
focus_escalation_note: Leaving the exam escalates: warning, final warning, then the answers are submitted and the exam closes at {count}. That is a submitted paper, not a void one — it is marked and published through the normal workflow. You review the evidence afterwards and rule the sitting a genuine attempt or malpractice.
focus_recorded_only_note: Leaving the exam is recorded but will not close it. Flagged sittings are still marked — you review the evidence and rule each one a genuine attempt or malpractice.
guided_already_selected: Already selected {count} of {count} - deselect one first
guided_could_not_save: Could not save this section's picks.
guided_no_matching_body: Nothing in the bank matches this section's subject, type and difficulty yet.
guided_no_sections_body: Go back and add at least one section with a selection rule before picking questions.
guided_not_enough_body: Only {count, plural, one {# matching question is} other {# matching questions are}} available in the Question Bank. Please add more questions to the bank, or change this section's requirements.
not_in_exam_hint: Leave it in the bank, but do not put it in this exam
preset_for_section: Type and difficulty are pre-set to {type} so this section can use it.
problem_add_section: Add at least one section with selection rules.
problem_duration_exceeds_window: The {minutes}-minute duration is longer than the exam window.
problem_pick_subject: Pick the subject this exam belongs to.
problem_section_needs_rule: Every section needs at least one selection rule.
problem_set_window: Set when the exam opens and closes.
problem_window_order: The exam window must end after it starts.
started_from_example: Started from the worked example — rewrite it.
step1_desc: Choose the operating mode for this examination. Both modes draw directly from your unified question bank.
toast_blueprint_filled: {count, plural, one {# section} other {# sections}} filled from the bank
toast_blueprint_partial: {filled}/{total} rows fully filled - some rows need more bank questions
toast_questions_added_to_section: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} added to {section}
unpin_hint: Keep it in the exam, but let any section draw it
use_as_starting_point: Use this as a starting point
writing_for_rule: Writing for {section} · rule {rule}. Type and difficulty are pre-set to {type} so this rule can draw it. Change either and the rule will skip it.
